purpose: y2s72-libmerge3: libredwoodair.dylib = y2s70-libmerge2 (libmerge1 + NR2) + fix for the libmerge2 camera stall: the GPU exposure-statistics shader (camstats, air_isp.c) is written as a loop instead of 64 unrolled cells (Panfrost compile 42-48 s / 183 KB on host -> ~5 ms / 3.4 KB), shaders are built on a library thread (redwoodair-ispwarm) with a 250 ms bounded wait on the camera thread (CPU fallback via the userland), 5 s retry, GPU path off after 3 consecutive failed/slow (>1 s) renders. Built in gpu/build/y2s72-libmerge3 (libmerge3.diff on y2s70-libmerge2/src, src/build.sh). Accepts the base, thumbrc, camstats1, gnr1, libmerge1 or libmerge2; Nord2Metal thumbsync, vt23, thumbstage, thumbfix (y2s73, the phone state at 15:28) or gpuview (unchanged). Backup libredwoodair.dylib.pre-libmerge3, receipt record libmerge3; undo: guest-libmerge3-undo.sh.
